question_text: Outline why an ordinary queue is suitable for equally urgent document jobs sent to a printer.
adaptation_rationale: FIFO queue application explicitly scoped. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: New jobs enqueue at rear; printer dequeues front so earliest submitted jobs are served first.

marking_points.criterion: Rear enqueue and front dequeue linked to fair printing.
